ATTENTION ALL FANS! IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING GEMINI NORAWIT'S PHILIPPINE SCHEDULE!

We have received a crucial update regarding Gemini's visit to the Philippines. The initial announcement stated a one-day event on August 8, 2025. However, we are now thrilled to confirm that this will be a TWO-DAY EVENT!

Mark your calendars for both AUGUST 8 AND AUGUST 9, 2025!

Here's a breakdown of the updated schedule and essential guidelines:

August 8, 2025 (Friday): FAN DAY with Gemini! This is your primary opportunity to see him.

August 9, 2025 (Saturday): This will be a Private/Exclusive Media Session at the same venue. Fans are still welcome to come and see him, especially if you are unable to attend on Friday.

Crucial Guidelines & Reminders for Both Days:

NO SEAT RESERVATIONS ARE ALLOWED.

To ensure everyone's safety and maintain order, please avoid bringing heavy meals such as rice (snacks are allowed) or setting up anything that might cause commotion or crowding.

We kindly request your cooperation in keeping the area safe and tidy.

No loitering will be permitted in the area.

We request everyone to join the trending of the official hashtag on both days. Please stay tune for the official hashtag.

Your cooperation ensures a smooth and enjoyable experience for everyone. Let's make both days memorable for Gemini!
